hypotheses.title: Keep causal-chain scheduling priorities through replay suffixes and demote chains at sampled change points
hypotheses.description: Use the existing prefix-replay treatment population to test a PCT-style causal-chain scheduler after the existing signal-cut tape is exhausted. Parent admission, tape cut, capacity, eight-child limit and plan-only control remain exactly as in the baseline. Add run-local chain identifiers for executable records and ChannelSend continuations. Before activation maintain identity propagation but leave effective priorities unchanged. A client request, timer firing, initialization/recovery root or otherwise parentless event starts a chain; RPC calls, asynchronous sends, spawned receiver records and their continuations inherit their creator's chain. A channel wakeup preserves the waiting reader's chain; it does not merge unrelated chains. Pending pre-cut records whose ancestry was not tracked receive separate root identifiers at activation. After tape exhaustion, activate only once the child's own existing ghost-with-pending-crash signal has fired. Draw two distinct future change points uniformly without replacement over the remaining frozen cap; if fewer than three steps remain, stay inert. Use a private deterministic hash stream seeded from the child schedule seed, with no reads from simulator RNG streams. Give chains a deterministic random total order keyed by that seed and chain id. At each change point demote the chain of the last executed executable record below all chains not yet demoted; retain this relative order for the rest of the suffix. A second demotion of the same chain is counted and changes no other order. Do not globally pick events by this order: run the stock queue-class draw, including timer-context bias and its empty-queue fallbacks. In the existing within-queue selector, use the chain key as a lexicographic ranking above the original score only among the exact candidates that the tournament already sampled; equal-chain candidates use the original score and index tie behavior. For the non-tournament selector, use the ordinary selected event unchanged and count that exclusion, so the mechanism does not silently redefine proportional selection. Preserve ordinary priority draws at creation even when chain keys govern ranking. Existing reservations, FIFO, crash holds, fresh-first, pair-order and client request release still run, and instrumentation compares the final legal pick with the stock sampled pick without drawing more randomness. Non-executable faults and timers keep their original scoring; their created executable descendants acquire or inherit chains. Add chain propagation in core/state.rs, core/exec.rs, core/scheduler.rs and path.rs, activation information in explorer.rs/rng.rs, and utilization exports/tests. Do not alter hashes, trace ids, causal_operation_id, protocol state or logging. No config field, nested dose, new treatment bit, state checkpoint or shared learner.
hypotheses.rationale: The unattempted causal-chain idea has a verified missing object: records retain priority through local continuations, but newly sent records draw independently at every hop. PCT demotions need a persistent chain to move as a unit. The existing tournament offers real authority once candidates are sampled; comparing chain order directly over that same candidate set avoids assuming that multiplying a narrow score band can change eligibility or queue choice. Restricting the policy to supplied early replay suffixes places coherent execution and subsequent interleaving changes near an observed fault race while preserving the original path to it. This is not a hold on an origin or recovery class and does not claim that long queue-free stretches were absent before. Two change points are the structural depth-three PCT search choice, not an empirical dose sweep. PCT probability bounds for fixed threads do not transfer to dynamically spawned chains; the claim here is empirical search utility. Ordinary signal-cut parents and existing same-step return counts suggest applicability, but the new child activation, sampled multi-chain contests and surviving suffix must be measured.
hypotheses.generalityArgument: The persistent unit is causality in the simulator's execution graph, independent of message names, contents, protocol roles or oracle labels. Any protocol with asynchronous sends can exhibit chains whose relative interleaving matters. Queue selection, timer admission, legal event sets and fault semantics remain the same. The protocol panel must verify both clean behavior and known-bug discovery; throughput or selective VR depth alone cannot establish general value.

treatmentBit.name: replayPrefix
treatmentBit.share: The existing salted half of replay slots, approximately one quarter of non-probe grid runs; unchanged assignment and empty-slot behavior.
treatmentBit.control: The existing replay-slot runs without replayPrefix, which reuse a parent's configuration and workload and run a fresh schedule. Non-slot runs and AOS receive no new policy.
treatmentBit.identity: The bit continues to mean schedule-prefix replay from a corpus parent. No new bit, nested run-id dose, campaign arm, or protected registration edit. This is a replacement of the prefix-replay search mechanism, not a reinterpretation of a selector or fault bit.
treatmentBit.contrast: Intention to treat on all prefix-tagged slots, including unfilled and failed branch attempts, probe-free and matched on existing co-bits. Also compute the candidate prefix/plan-only ratio divided by the paired baseline prefix/plan-only ratio. A filled-only ratio is descriptive, never the treatment estimate.
treatmentBit.inverse: No additional inverse cell: alternatives and initial chain orders are sampled symmetrically, and neither search procedure has a single protocol-independent signed inverse. They are stochastic policies inside the one existing prefix-replay mechanism, not hidden run-id treatment doses.

prediction.mechanism: The probe-free, co-bit-matched prefix/plan-only per-run ratio will be1.20-1.60; its ratio to the paired baseline contrast will be1.15-1.50. Fixed four-grid-arm primary events/sec>=1.06 baseline, whole-campaign events/sec>=1.03 baseline, and AOS depth8 per run>=0.95 baseline. These are separate predictions, not estimates inferred by dividing grid utility by whole-campaign throughput.
prediction.independentObservable: Per300-second chunk, >=40000 prefix children activate before their own cap, >=25000 active children execute >=8 subsequent steps, and >=15000 active children reach at least one change point. At least20% of eligible suffix tournament decisions have >=2 distinct chains in the candidates actually sampled. On those multi-chain sampled contests the final legal winner differs from the shadow stock winner at least15% of the time; fresh-first/pair-order overwrites and same-chain ties are separate counts. Among active children with at least eight suffix dispatches, median consecutive executable dispatches sharing one chain rises at least25% over plan-only children measured after their own first signal, while realized timer dispatch share stays within10% relative of that control. The latter comparison is descriptive and reports readiness/arm strata; the randomized all-slot contrast decides utility. Emit activation delay from tape exhaustion, frozen remaining-cap bins, excluded selector type, change points reached, distinct chains sampled, inherited cross-node sends, same-chain ties, shadow-choice changes before and after merged preferences, and per-arm chain-run-length histograms. Existing counters cannot currently report these quantities; all are added with the mechanism.
prediction.falsifier: Refuted if the matched treatment contrast interval lies wholly below1.20 or its paired baseline-adjusted contrast lies wholly below1.15. Supply below40000 active runs, below15000 reached change points, multi-chain contest share below20%, final dispatch authority below15%, or chain persistence growth below25% refutes the claimed mechanism. A timer-share change above10% requires closing this specification because preserving timer admission in code did not preserve the claimed exposure. Primary<=baseline with more coherent chains is not success. Repeated AOS ratio below0.95 or whole-campaign utility loss prevents merge despite a grid gain. Report replay-family sensitivity rather than treating sibling runs as independent evidence.
prediction.costClause: Cross-binary whole-campaign throughput>=0.97 of paired baseline. The original cap, completed-plan termination and number of histories are unchanged. Do not skip baseline priority samples to claim a speedup: byte-consumption parity is part of the mechanism. All trace and client-history semantics remain ordinary. If supply or dispatch authority fails in the first normal chunk, close before additional chunks/panel. Additional ancestry storage is at most one u64 chain id per executable or buffered executable object, with measured Rust layout growth at most16 bytes per affected Record/ChannelSend/partition-buffered message representation. Run-local chain control and observation storage is at most1024 bytes, excluding existing state and the one chain id per object; use fixed-size counters/histograms. Retain at most two demoted chain ids and derive other chain priorities directly from seed/id, with no dynamically growing per-chain map, ancestry graph or per-step log. Export the relevant size_of layout measurements, maximum run-local allocated bytes, maximum retained demotion entries and count of root allocations; verify fixed bounds against the ordinary trial. Peak process RSS may be reported descriptively but has no paired ratio gate.
prediction.measurementClarification: The20% multi-chain sampled contest share uses all eligible suffix tournament decisions. The15% final choice-change fraction is restricted to multi-chain samples with an executable stock winner, as frozen by the mixed-fault rule; report both denominators and exclusions. New chain metadata and all control histograms must be explicitly implemented. This is a prefix-replay-plus-causal-chain replacement policy contrast versus plan-only, not a randomized estimate of chain ranking alone. Raw1.20-1.60 and paired baseline-adjusted1.15-1.50 remain separate bands; use the existing grader without registration or protocol changes.
prediction.memoryMeasurementClarification: Pre-admission memory correction: the current same-identity baseline cache contains no RSS/resident/peak-memory fields and no matching baseline peak is available in retained observations. A valid paired peak would require additional baseline acquisition, not reinterpretation of a cached metric. No new baseline run, calibration-only round, identity change or cache mutation is authorized by this proposal. The unsupported peak-RSS ratio is therefore removed before admission and replaced by directly checkable bounds on additional mechanism-owned storage. These bounds constrain bookkeeping/corpus growth; they are NOT a claim that total process RSS is unchanged or below the original1.25x/1.15x thresholds. Actual process peak, if collected during the ordinary candidate chunk, is descriptive only.

hypotheses.sourceVerification: Source verified: campaign.rs GridArm admits fresh parents at state.replay_cut, serves CAPACITY=64 and CHILDREN_PER_PARENT=8 round-robin, and distinguishes prefix children from plan-only children. No children are admitted. rng.rs Recording is an Arc<[u64]> and RecRng exposes recording position; replay currently has no public consumed-tape-length/finished-prefix query. core/scheduler.rs computes eligibility with reservations, FIFO, crash holds, and down-victim guards before queue/within-queue choice. Existing replay fidelity is only equality of the child's first signal step with seed.cut_step, not state equality. Baseline seed1000 records 72959 parents,108506 filled prefix children,107830 plan-only children,18454 unfilled slots and56198 same-step signal returns. These are ordinary 300-second supply observations, not proof that the proposed narrower action predicate will fire. Existing source draws new priorities at sends and roots; continuation resumption retains a Record priority. No protected files need editing. Additional verified details: WithinQueueSelector defaults to Tournament{k:10}; select_within_queue samples eligible candidates using Stream::WithinQueue. Queue-class selection separately applies timer_context before within-queue selection. Record has send_ordinal, origin_incarnation, entry_pc and causal_operation_id but no generic chain id. ChannelSend currently has no causal-operation or chain field, so cross-channel propagation must be designed explicitly rather than inferred from client-operation ids.
hypotheses.notes: Complete previously frozen specification retained. Iteration71 revalidates eligibility and score without changing predictions; inherited review evidence is explicitly historical.

review.redTeam: PCT fixed-thread guarantees do not apply here: chains spawn dynamically, queues are selected separately, only sampled candidates can compete, and merged preferences can overwrite chain order. Most contests may be singleton/same-chain, or the stock winner may be a fault, leaving little authority. A chain can also fan out widely and dominate scheduling until a late cap-relative demotion, suppressing the very mixed-origin order sought. Two cap-uniform change points often occur after plan completion. Preserving timer admission code does not preserve realized timer exposure. Cross-channel ancestry can be lost in buffering/recovery, or parentless roots can collapse into one chain. Carrying metadata on every record may cost more than sparse prefix-child authority can repay.
review.dedupe: A concrete revised descendant of the unbuilt causal-chain-priority-inheritance-with-demotion-points; that historical parent is not a second independent keep. Unlike the old proposal it preserves priority draws and queue-class selection, so neither old claims of free speedup nor old scoring-placebo nulls decide this algorithm. Same replay-family utility/supply concerns as frontier, but persistent causal ordering is a different actuator; score5 reflects unmeasured authority.
review.costReason: Fixed rubric cost2: explicitly edits core/exec.rs and propagates metadata through record/continuation lifecycles. No cost for code size.
requiredImplementationConstraints: Keep the original parent tapes, cuts, corpus service, slot assignment and plan-only scheduling. Activate once in an actually filled prefix child, only after source tape exhaustion and its own signal. Raw source exhaustion and output position are separate; an unfilled prefix-tagged fresh run is inert. No run-id subdose or additional algorithm switch.

For a tournament, draw the exact same candidate sequence and compute its stock winner first. If the stock winner is non-executable, preserve it unchanged. Otherwise choose the highest ordered chain among only executable candidates in that SAME sample, breaking same-chain ties by ordinary score and original first-sampled tie behavior. This freezes the previously ambiguous mixed-fault comparison without giving records blanket precedence. Count stock-non-executable exclusion separately.

Apply ordinary fresh-first/pair-order after the proposed within-queue pick, with pure shadow preview and one actual bookkeeping/commit path. Preserve proportional and singleton selection and all priority samples. Never use the chain id in state hashes, trace ids, client operation ids or eligibility.

Initialization, recovery, client invocation and timer-resumed record each start a distinct deterministic run-local root chain. Async-created records inherit the current executable chain; synchronous calls remain within it. Ordinary channel wakeups preserve the waiting reader chain, not the sender chain. Timer wakeup is the explicitly declared new-root exception. Preserve chain metadata on continuations, crash reset/re-delivery, delayed queues, partition buffering/healing and channel-send completion; add core/partition.rs plumbing if needed within subject bounds.

Track pre-activation identities for the diagnostics on plan-only and fresh runs as well as prefix children, but do not apply chain ranking there. Missing ancestry receives distinct roots rather than one shared sentinel. Report missing-ancestry allocation count. No additional state transition, RNG sample or learner credit is justified by instrumentation.

Draw two distinct future absolute scheduling-step change points from the remaining cap with a private hash sampler; they are fixed at activation. Demote the last actually executed executable chain at each reached point; if none has executed, count a no-chain point and remain unchanged. Previously demoted chains stay below all never-demoted chains, first demotion below the latter, second new-chain demotion below the first; repeat demotion of the same chain is a counted no-op.

Chain-run-length histograms use consecutive executed Record or ChannelSend dispatches after the comparison cut; any intervening fault, timer, blocked/no-execution dispatch or another chain ends a run. Median comparison includes censored final stretches explicitly and reports readiness/arm strata. The control cut is its own first signal, not the parent tape cut. It remains a descriptive selected-subpopulation comparison.

Multi-chain authority denominator consists of active-suffix tournament decisions with at least two distinct executable chains actually sampled and an executable stock winner. Report the unconditional multi-chain sampled share over all eligible active-suffix tournament decisions separately. Final legal winner15% criterion uses the authority denominator. Counter-only shadow choices consume no RNG or mutable preference side effects.

Memory counters must include backing allocation capacity, not just logical lengths, for new dynamic storage. Do not allocate a parent/node trace table and omit it from the declared memory accounting. Validate fixed layout/ownership bounds without a new baseline performance experiment. Diagnostic truncation cannot change aggregate firing or applicability denominators.

core/exec.rs draws a new priority for Async-created Record and remote ChannelSend; path.rs draws for client roots; core/scheduler.rs draws for recovery roots. Existing local continuations and ordinary channel wakeups retain their Record. Thus hop-wise priorities are not persistent; priority within one resumed Record already is.

Record has no chain id. Runnable::ChannelSend and partition::QueuedMessage::ChannelSend currently carry no chain id. The partition buffering/heal path reconstructs ChannelSend fields and must explicitly preserve new metadata; it cannot be covered by only changing the initial constructor.

Mixed local tournaments can contain executable records and faults. A lexicographic chain key assigned to only records has no meaningful comparison with unkeyed faults until a rule is specified. Merely saying faults retain scores does not preserve their winning opportunities.

hypotheses.title: Learn different scheduling compositions for fresh plans and replay searches
hypotheses.description: Condition the existing arm selector's five direction distributions on the actual search behavior that issued a run: Fresh, PlanReuse, PrefixReplay, or TapeMutation. Keep the existing shared cell, shared exploration-share calculation, learner assignment, rewards, five axes, discount, warmup, and coin-to-all/own-run-to-own credit rule. Inside each CellLearner, add bounded direction evidence for its observed search contexts. A learner draw with at least 24 prior credited observations in its actual context uses context direction posteriors shrunk toward the existing shared direction means; otherwise it uses the existing shared sampler. For direction d, the contextual Beta parameters are 1 + 24 * shared.mean(d) + context.alpha[d] and 1 + 24 * (1 - shared.mean(d)) + context.beta[d]. Compute the existing pairwise-normal leading probabilities from those parameters, multiply by the unchanged coin direction shares, and sample each axis with the existing selector generator. No change to how the shared state decides coin versus learner. Credit the shared and matching context evidence under one existing cell guard; do not credit another context. Each context discounts only its carried directions with the existing DISCOUNT=0.998, as the shared direction evidence does. Add an explicit search-context field to RunAttribution and pass it to choose and observe. GridRun::Fresh, including an unfilled replay slot, is Fresh; a real child is PlanReuse or PrefixReplay according to its actual execution branch. AOS ConfigMutate and initial seeds are Fresh; actual TapeMutate is TapeMutation. Apply the same attribution in existing standalone/curriculum record-and-replay callers. Default callers without reuse to Fresh. This changes how scheduling directions compose with existing search behaviors within the fixed arms; it does not alter the campaign, corpus admission/service, AOS operator bandit, plans, tapes, execution, caps, or run tags. Source scope: simulator/arm_selector.rs, explorer.rs, campaign.rs, util_stats.rs, and directly required tests/export plumbing under spur/.
buildsOn: per-cell factored direction selector with three existing rewards
grid fresh, plan-only and prefix-replay execution branches
hypotheses.rationale: The selector currently uses one direction-evidence pool for a grid configuration even though fresh runs, reused workloads and replayed schedules have different sources of ordering. AOS similarly puts fresh/config-mutated and tape-mutated scenarios in its one non-grid cell. The actual search operator is known before a scheduling direction is selected. A direction can be useful for constructing a fresh prefix but counterproductive while perturbing an inherited one; blending those outcomes estimates a mixture whose composition changes with replay supply and AOS operator allocation. This proposal lets those searches choose different combinations while retaining the shared coin policy and shrinking sparse context evidence toward the current pooled estimate. Existing observations establish that replay fidelity depends strongly on mechanism choices and that selector changes can have opposite grid/AOS effects, but neither proves the proposed context interaction or its sign. The proposal therefore has a modest argument score and a strict normal-horizon supply and predictive-calibration gate. It is not a claim that any recorded AOS regression has been causally explained.
hypotheses.generalityArgument: The conditioning variable is the explorer's own choice to create a scenario, reuse its workload, replay a prefix, or perturb a tape. It uses no protocol role, handler, message name, oracle event, or bug identity. Each existing learner retains its existing generic reward. Every fixed grid arm and AOS can use the mechanism where it actually performs multiple search behaviors; a single-behavior mode still shrinks local evidence toward its shared estimator. The panel must decide whether this compositional specialization helps discovery across protocols.

prediction.mechanism: On the epoch-14 fixed four-grid-arm primary, fresh-session candidate/baseline depth>=8 probability per completed graded run will be in [1.12, 1.30], using the same four arms in each numerator and denominator. Context-specific direction weights should reduce the compromise between constructing new schedules and searching reused schedules. This is a cross-binary prediction, not a treated/untreated within-process ratio. Four independently reset normal 300-second paired chunks are required to claim confirmation. A 12 percent lower edge is deliberately above the recorded approximately 5 percent layout floor; repeated seeds do not eliminate systematic layout uncertainty. Do not infer a primary improvement from whole-campaign throughput or a change in arm mix.
prediction.independentObservable: On a fixed salted 1/16 sample of specialized learner runs, retain pre-execution contextual and shared marginal reward probabilities for the five actual chosen directions. Score both after completion against that learner's actual Boolean reward, before crediting that outcome. For each run use the mean of the five binary log losses, with both sets of probabilities clamped to [1e-12, 1-1e-12]. The ratio of summed contextual loss to summed shared loss will be <=0.98 over four completed paired chunks on the candidate, separately for the fixed grid arms and AOS. This is a prequential predictive diagnostic on the candidate's actual actions, not an off-policy causal estimate or independent treatment contrast. Also compute exact categorical total variation between the contextual and shared direction distributions at every specialized draw: mean over the five axes >=0.05, and at least one categorical argmax differs on >=0.15 of specialized draws. Ties use the existing lowest-index rule. These policy diagnostics do not consume schedule RNG or make a counterfactual run.
prediction.falsifier: Refute the primary prediction if its paired contrast interval lies entirely below 1.12; an interval entirely at or below 1.0 is therefore a refutation. Close as inapplicable if any normal-chunk supply gate fails. Refute the proposed predictive mechanism if the contextual/shared prequential log-loss ratio is >=1.0 on either grid or AOS after four chunks: larger loss is the wrong sign. Ratios above0.98 but below1.0 miss the frozen confirmation target. Close if mean categorical total variation is below0.05 or the changed-argmax share is below0.15 over the normal chunks. Close for any frozen cost, correctness or harm failure. A grid gain accompanied by AOS harm cannot confirm general composition utility.
prediction.treatment: No treatment bit is proposed. ARM_SELECTOR_AXIS=1<<6, ARM_SELECTOR_AXIS_B=1<<5, ARM_SELECTOR_AXIS_C=1<<7 and ARM_SELECTOR_CONCENTRATED=1<<8 name endogenous realized learner choices, not randomized assignment to this mechanism. REPLAY_SLOT=1<<20 and REPLAY_PREFIX=1<<21 still name their existing grid search assignments; none names context specialization on/off, and AOS carries neither. Do not relabel these bits or treat their strata as randomized treatment controls. Protected orchestrator registration remains untouched. This proposal requests an explicit cross-binary exception at admission. A per-run old/new switch is technically possible. Such an experiment with shared adaptive state would measure partial exposure to specialized outcomes; isolated states would additionally halve each policy's learning supply and change the finite-horizon search being tested. The scientific estimand here is the complete coupled context-policy system at the existing normal session supply, including its influence on later direction evidence and AOS search selection. This is a reason to consider cross-binary grading, not a claim that randomized testing is impossible. If that exception is not accepted, reject the proposal in its current form rather than silently changing bit semantics or the experiment.
prediction.supplyGates: Per normal 300-second candidate chunk: specialized_learner_draws>=100000; specialized draws comprise>=0.75 of non-probe learner draws separately in grid and AOS; each actual grid context Fresh, PlanReuse and PrefixReplay contributes>=5000 specialized draws; each actual AOS context Fresh and TapeMutation contributes>=1000 specialized draws. For the prequential sample, at least1000 scored grid runs and100 scored AOS runs per chunk. Export actual context assignment counts, unfilled-slot Fresh counts, warmed/fallback draws and credited runs by context/learner and by grid/AOS, so tags or intended operators cannot substitute for actual supply. Do not lower warmup or these floors after observing supply.
prediction.costClause: Paired cross-binary whole-campaign throughput>=0.97 of baseline, each existing campaign arm throughput>=0.95, and cumulative epoch throughput>=0.90. Fixed-grid and whole-campaign depth>=8 events per explore-second each>=1.08 of baseline for confirmation. AOS depth>=8 per-run probability and per-second rate each>=0.95 of baseline; fixed-grid depth>=6 per-run probability>=0.98. Keep all existing regression/panel requirements. At most four context evidence blocks per existing learner/cell, with only twelve alpha/beta pairs and scalar observation counters in each; fixed-size diagnostic snapshots and no retained per-run corpus are permitted. Report bounded byte cost and created context counts. No new locks, whole-queue scans, extra execution or longer tapes. Log-loss evaluation only on the fixed 1/16 diagnostic sample; the exact TV/argmax counters reuse the direction probability vectors already computed for selection and its shared comparison. Shared hot-path overhead is evaluated cross-binary, not hidden behind selector strata.
implementationConstraints: Preserve the current shared CellLearner update equations, selector cell keys, learner assignment salts, probe exemptions, exploration-share calculation, five categorical schedule-independent draws, and coin-to-all/own-run-to-own reward exposure. Add matching-context updates inside that same permitted credit call. A coin run is never specialized but its actual search context is credited under the existing all-learner rule.

Use actual issuing behavior from GridRun and AOS Operator. A replay slot that runs fresh because the corpus is empty must be Fresh. Do not infer context from run-id arithmetic, realized reward, tape fidelity or outcome. AOS seeds and ConfigMutate are Fresh even if the mutated configuration equals its parent's.

The 24-observation threshold is per context and learner, counting the observations admitted by the existing credit rule. The shared warmup and exploration decision run first. Context evidence may be collected while a shared cell is young, but specialization cannot bypass the shared warmup or convert a coin run into a learner run.

Read shared means, context evidence, and both diagnostic probability vectors in the same cell snapshot. Store any sampled prequential probabilities with the run's selector choice before releasing it for execution. Score against the matching learner reward before that completed outcome is credited; never substitute a later updated posterior or another learner's outcome.

Use the existing direction-visit discount on local alpha/beta and explicit local raw observation count. Contexts update on their own visits, so their effective horizon in total cell runs differs from the shared evidence; this is part of the specified mechanism and a possible source of stale estimates, not a common-clock claim.

Retain existing run_variant semantics and all utilization fields. Add bounded context counters, prequential loss sums/counts, TV sums and changed-argmax counts to the normal utilization export. Reset every new state/counter with the existing session reset. Do not modify the campaign block or any protected file.

Focused deterministic tests cover actual context attribution, sparse-context fallback, contextual posterior formulas, independent context credit, unchanged shared/probe/coin rules, schedule RNG consumption, prequential-before-credit snapshots, session reset and utilization export. They are correctness tests only; use the candidate grader for every performance/effect/supply measurement.

hypotheses.description: Replace independent arm-axis sampling on learner draws with a bounded population search in simulator/arm_selector.rs. Each existing learner/configuration cell retains a ring of its last WARMUP_OBSERVATIONS successful full ArmSet vectors, with their credited-observation indices. Admit vectors only from runs that the learner already observes under its existing coin-or-own-run exposure rule and that earn its unchanged Boolean reward. Repeated vectors from independent successful runs remain repeated population members; no execution tape, plan, workload or state is copied. When at least eight live successes spanning at least two distinct vectors are present, a learner draw samples one population member uniformly and mutates exactly one axis. Choose the mutation axis proportionally to the categorical entropy of that axis's current normalized posterior-leading probabilities, and draw a different direction from the existing coin shares renormalized over the alternatives. If all entropies vanish, choose the axis uniformly. Thus four coordinates preserve a successful joint setting while uncertain coordinates receive exploration. Cells below support retain the current independent marginal sampler. Keep the current adaptive coin share, marginal posteriors, three learner assignments and rewards, per-configuration pooling, cap and all scheduler mechanisms unchanged. Population admission and aging share the current credit write guard. A cell's ordinary coin runs remain fresh exploration, and replay behavior and ordinary reward credit semantics remain unchanged. At draw time aggregate this parent-and-mutation mixture into the exact categorical distribution over the 72 ArmSet values, then sample that distribution. For an observation-only comparison, use the same uniform variate and fixed ArmSet index order to sample the product of the current marginal axis distributions; identical distributions therefore produce no departure. Count the Hamming distance between the actual tuple and this comparison tuple. Record mutation-axis mass from the exact mixture, and add counters and bounded per-cell exports for live support, unique vectors, supported draws, joint total-variation distance and subsequent reward counts on population-sampled runs. Cache the population mixture after each credited update that changes the population, refreshing the entropy weights after every WARMUP_OBSERVATIONS credits. Comparison calculations consume no schedule random numbers. No config field, campaign arm or harness change.
hypotheses.rationale: The existing joint Thompson proposal was weak because 72 combinations divide a discounted window into too few observations to estimate all combination reward rates. Successful-vector resampling uses observed successful tuples directly and needs no estimate for every combination. It also avoids recombining five separately favorable directions into a tuple that was never successful together, a structural limitation left largely unchanged when conditional draws seldom depart from marginal choices. Broad existing reward supply makes the population support falsifiable at the normal horizon. The main risks are reinforcement of frequently sampled tuples, loss of useful multi-axis jumps, and reward/depth misalignment. Independent coin draws and entropy-directed mutation provide escape paths, but they do not prove these risks harmless.
hypotheses.generalityArgument: Population members are complete settings of general scheduling mechanisms, and their fitness is one of the existing protocol-independent rewards. The same success-and-mutation rule works for any protocol's action effects without inspecting handler names, roles, message payloads, oracle traces or known violations. Configurations and workloads are still chosen by the existing campaign; only the mechanism settings of a new execution are adapted.

Choose uniformly among eligible edges using a private deterministic stream derived from the child's schedule seed with a new fixed salt; remove u->v and add v->u. The absence of another u-to-v path makes this reversal acyclic. Reverse exactly one eligible edge, with no acceptance fitness or retry search; use the unmodified parent graph if the eligible set is empty. Never add nodes, change actions or targets, delete mandatory dependencies, or change total edge count.
